title: Corporate Media “Happily Manufacturing Consent” for Iran War- So What Are You Going to Do About It?
author: Team Zeteo
content:
We saw it with Gaza and we're seeing it again in Iran. Legacy media is failing
us when it comes to holding power to account for the devastating US-Israeli
war in Iran. From softball CBS interviews, to the _New York Times_ burying the
attack on a girls school on page 11, **Mehdi** says leading media outlets are
"happily manufacturing consent for this devastating and illegal war."

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

But at **Zeteo** , we're leading with the "blunt honesty and moral clarity"
you're searching for. Listen to **Mehdi** play out exactly how **Zeteo** is
pushing back against corporate media and why more than ever your subscriber
support matters.
